title: A second keep scan changes nothing
statement: Let $A$ be a state set, let $\Gamma$ be a symbol set, let $\delta_f:A\to\Gamma\to A\times\Gamma$ be a transition that reads and possibly changes a symbol, let $a_0\in A$, and let $w$ be a finite word over $\Gamma$. A two-pass scan first runs this transition from left to right over $w$, then runs a transition that leaves both state and symbols unchanged from right to left over the first output in reverse. The resulting state and word equal those from the first pass alone.
